_README: Human curation decisions applied on top of raw_responses/ by merge_validate.py.
Raw response JSONs are never edited: they stay the verbatim extraction record.
Every decision that changes articles.csv or ae_events_observational.csv relative
to that record belongs here, so the pipeline is reproducible from raw_responses/
+ this file alone.
Sections:
exclude    - StudyID -> reason. Drops the article and all of its AE events.
conditions - StudyID -> conditions the study contributes to. A study with two
or more conditions gets one articles.csv row per condition (the
downstream tables de-duplicate on StudyID for participant counts).
fields     - StudyID -> field -> {value, reason}. Single-field overrides.
A StudyID named here that is absent from raw_responses/ is a hard validation
failure, so stale entries cannot rot silently.
PROVENANCE: the exclusions and condition assignments reproduce the 2026-08-07
two-reviewer curation pass described in the manuscript Methods — outcome
guardrails flagged 10 observational records as possibly not matching this
study's measures, and two human reviewers removed 6, leaving 33. That pass
recorded no per-study reasons; the per-study wording below was reconstructed on
2026-08-13 from each record's Condition='.' extraction and title, and needs
reviewer confirmation before publication. The decisions themselves are
reproduced exactly.

exclude.Cakic 2010: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Dimethyltryptamine (DMT): Subjective effects and patterns of use among Australian recreational users' — recreational-use survey with no alcohol, smoking, or opioid outcome. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.
exclude.Chandler 1960: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Lysergic Acid Diethylamide (LSD-25) as a Facilitating Agent in Psychotherapy' — general psychotherapy series, not a substance-use-disorder treatment cohort. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.
exclude.Halpern 2005: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Psychological and Cognitive Effects of Long-Term Peyote Use Among Native Americans' — cognitive-effects study of ritual use, no SUD treatment outcome. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.
exclude.Langner 1965: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Six Years' Experience with LSD Therapy' — mixed-indication clinical series with no extractable N and no condition-specific outcome. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.
exclude.O'Shaughnessy 2021: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Within-treatment changes in a novel addiction treatment program using traditional Amazonian medicine' — mixed-addiction program not resolvable to alcohol, smoking, or opioid. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.
exclude.Schenberg 2014: Condition='.' in extraction. 'Treating drug dependence with the aid of ibogaine: A retrospective study' — mixed drug-dependence cohort not resolvable to the three target conditions. Excluded in the 2026-08-07 curation pass.

IsObservational.reason: Resolves the non-blocking IsObservational=N design warning the extraction raised (2026-08-13). The extracted paper is the naturalistic two-year follow-up survey, not the parent dosing protocol, and it carries no control or comparator group; the extractor set N on the strength of the randomized DPT/DET/6-FDET administration described in the parent protocol's Methods. Human review resolved the borderline call to Y.
